description:
Following the Flames is a fire investigation training channel dedicated to the science, methodology, and professional standards behind origin and cause determination.

This channel focuses on investigator education through real-world examples, case analysis, fire dynamics, pattern recognition, electrical and mechanical failure discussion, scene documentation, and report writing—always grounded in the scientific method and nationally recognized best practices.

Designed for fire investigators, inspectors, fire marshals, engineers, students, and public-safety professionals, Following the Flames emphasizes critical thinking, bias awareness, and continual professional development.

Whether you’re preparing for certification, sharpening your skills, or expanding your understanding of fire behavior, this channel is about learning how to think like an investigator—not just what to look for.
